test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If Sundar borrows Rs. 45000 from Jethalal at rate of interest 8% per annum simple interest. How much interest Sundar has to pay at the end of five years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 45000

Rate of interest (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (45000 × 8 × 5) / 100

SI = 1800000 / 100

SI = 18000

**The interest Sundar has to pay at the end of five years is Rs. 18000.**
